runner_usd_per_min.what: GitHub Actions list price of a standard Linux 2-core x64 runner (SKU actions_linux), the price the same runs-on: ubuntu-24.04 jobs would pay in a private repo. Public repos run them free (on a 4-core machine). GitHub rounds each job up to the next whole minute.
runner_usd_per_min.source: GitHub Docs, Actions runner pricing (docs.github.com/en/billing/reference/actions-runner-pricing), read on 23 Oct 2026 from the docs source (github/docs, content/billing/reference/actions-runner-pricing.md and data/reusables/billing/actions-standard-runner-prices.md at commit d67ced7 of 13 Oct 2026); the same page lists Linux 4-core at US$0.012 a minute.

mac_watts.unit: W at the wall while rendering
mac_watts.what: MacBook Air (M4) rendering in Blender (Metal GPU, fanless). Assumed, not measured: 30 W is the rating of the smallest power adapter Apple ships with it, a round upper figure for a sustained render on mains.
mac_watts.source: not looked up: support.apple.com was not reachable from the session that built this (23 Oct 2026). Measure it once with a plug meter or "sudo powermetrics" and update this line.

kwh_cad.what: Ontario residential electricity, all in (energy, delivery, regulatory). Assumed round figure.
kwh_cad.source: not looked up: oeb.ca was not reachable from the session that built this (23 Oct 2026). Check the Ontario Energy Board rates page and a recent hydro bill, then update this line.

how: Paid: every call our code made to a paid model, from the ledger.json files the pipelines commit. Measured means the provider reported the cost; estimated means our code priced it (speech by the characters sent, a fallback price); not flagged means old code that did not record which.
A failed call that still cost money is kept and flagged. Free models cost US$0.
The log: sentences in docs/LOG.md with a US$ figure and the film's name. When a ledger exists the log figure is only a cross-check, never added.

GitHub runners: the job times of every run written down for the film, rounded up to whole minutes per job as GitHub bills them. Free on public repos; worth is the list price for the same jobs in a private repo.
Mac lane: render time from the job logs on the drive, with an electricity estimate from an assumed wattage and an assumed price per kWh (both marked as not verified).
Not recorded means nothing was written down. Nothing here is a guess presented as a fact.
